languageIntro: Choose the language you want to see and speak in.
editGuide: Tap the circle. Tell us what to change in your listing.
startGuide: Start below to make your listing by voice.
speakPlace: Tap the circle. Say the city or area.
speakNeed: Tap the circle. Tell us what you need.
offerIntro: Offer a service from home. Just speak; we will build your entry together.
tagline: Speak in your language. Get a clear next step.
chooseAction: Choose what you want to do
resultCount: Result {index} of {total}. Say next, previous, or repeat.
noMatches: No entries match yet. Say another service or area, or invite a provider to join.
offerBegin: Create a local entry for the work you do. The assistant will ask one question at a time.
answerHint: Say your answer, then tap the microphone to finish speaking.
reviewPrivacy: Check your phone number and area. Your name, service area, and phone number will be visible in search. Do not include your home address. Say which detail to change if needed.
updateHint: To update this entry, tap the microphone and say the detail and its new value.
errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errorOffline: The service is offline. Please try again.
errorOfflineLater: The service is offline. Please try again later.
errorChooseLanguage: Choose a language. Then try again.
errorWait: Please wait a moment. Then try again.
errorNotHeard: I did not hear you. Please try again.
errorNotUnderstood: I could not understand that. Please try again.
errorDraftExpired: This listing draft expired. Start again.
errorOwnerLost: This device no longer has access to your listing.
errorInvalidListing: Please check that detail and try again.
errorDuplicate: This phone number already has a listing. Open it on the original device or ask the operator for a new access link.
errorMicrophone: Allow the microphone. Then try again.
errorSavedAccess: Could not load your listing. Your access is saved. Reload when the service is available.
errorSavedDraft: Could not load your draft. It is saved. Reload when the service is available.
errorReport: The report could not be sent. Please try again.
errorDelete: Could not delete your listing. Please try again.
noticeReport: Thanks. We will check this listing.
noticePaused: Your listing is paused and hidden from search.
noticeLive: Your listing is visible in search again.
confirmDelete: Delete your listing and its contact details from this directory? This cannot be undone.
name: Name
